comment.body: Thanks for the screenshot and follow-up conversion log. The log shows XML parser failures, including mismatched GlossSeeAlso/GlossDef tags, and the earlier suggestion that the output must always be a JSON object was retracted. Please provide a minimal exact clipboard input and the expected JSON output in fenced code blocks (or a small sanitized text attachment), and identify the selected paste action. This lets us distinguish valid XML being converted incorrectly from malformed XML falling back to another supported format. No additional generic logs are needed for that distinction.
